question: Based on the position in the English alphabetical order, three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• Difference of the position values of the last first and second letters according to English alphabetic series is (5).
 
• Difference of the position values of the last first and second letters according to English alphabetic series is (4).
 
• Difference of the position values of the last first and second letters according to English alphabetic series is (2).

So,

 
• IDAY
